name: CI Status Check
description: Checks GitHub Actions CI status before allowing git push
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Check CI status before git push
CMD="$1"
if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git\s+push'; then
  if command -v gh &>/dev/null; then
    BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)
    STATUS=$(gh run list --branch "$BRANCH" --limit 1 --json status --jq '.[0].status' 2>/dev/null)
    CONCLUSION=$(gh run list --branch "$BRANCH" --limit 1 --json conclusion --jq '.[0].conclusion' 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$STATUS" = "completed" ] && [ "$CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
      echo "WARNING: Last CI run on $BRANCH did not succeed (conclusion: $CONCLUSION)."
      echo "Consider fixing CI before pushing."
    fi
  fi
fi
exit 0
